answer: Stake-bond slashing at the bridge: each validator locks 10,000 tokens; a sybil cluster must post 10,000 per identity. The beacon samples 3 random attestations per epoch; conflicting votes trigger slashing of the full bond. A 20-identity farm risks 200,000 tokens against a walnut-sized reward pool, so expected value goes negative after the first detected equivocation. The mechanism works because identity cost scales linearly while slashing removes principal, making farming unprofitable.
